SELECT (p->>'account_id')::bigint + 76561197960265728 AS steam_id, (p->>'hero_id')::int AS hero_id, (p->>'win')::boolean AS win, jsonb_build_array(p->'item_0', p->'item_1', p->'item_2', p->'item_3', p->'item_4', p->'item_5') AS items_json, (p->>'gold_per_min')::int AS gold_per_min, (p->>'xp_per_min')::int AS xp_per_min, (p->>'kills')::int AS kills, (p->>'deaths')::int AS deaths, (p->>'assists')::int AS assists, (p->>'hero_damage')::bigint AS hero_damage, (p->>'tower_damage')::bigint AS tower_damage, (p->>'gold_spent')::int AS gold_spent FROM match_detail md, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(md.raw_json::jsonb->'players') AS p WHERE md.sync_status = 2 AND md.raw_json IS NOT NULL AND p->>'account_id' IS NOT NULL AND p->'item_0' IS NOT NULL
AND (p->>'account_id')::bigint + 76561197960265728 = #{steamId}::bigint
AND (p->>'hero_id')::int = #{heroId}
LIMIT 2000

SELECT item_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS games, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS win_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS wins FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT md.match_id, (p->>'account_id')::bigint + 76561197960265728 AS steam_id, (p->>'hero_id')::int AS hero_id, (p->>'win')::boolean AS win, item.value::int AS item_id FROM match_detail md, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(md.raw_json::jsonb->'players') AS p, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( jsonb_build_array(p->'item_0', p->'item_1', p->'item_2', p->'item_3', p->'item_4', p->'item_5') ) AS item WHERE md.sync_status = 2 AND md.raw_json IS NOT NULL AND p->>'account_id' IS NOT NULL AND item.value IS NOT NULL AND item.value::text != '0' AND item.value::text != '' AND item.value::text != 'null' AND (p->>'hero_id')::int = #{heroId} AND (p->>'account_id')::bigint + 76561197960265728 = #{steamId}::bigint ) t GROUP BY item_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
